body:
- **Always invoke the `/filemark` skill** before writing or editing any brainstorm, plan, problem, roadmap, ADR, or component-spec doc inside `docsi/` (private-repo). These files are read in filemark, so they must use the correct component grammar (`<Callout>`, `<Tabs>`, `<Details>`, `<Stats>`, `<ADR>`, `<Datagrid>`, `<Chart>`, `<Kanban>`, `<TaskList>`, `<TaskStats>`, `<TaskTimeline>`, sigil task bullets, filter DSL) and observe the two HTML-in-markdown survival rules.
- Applies to **every file under `docsi/`** — `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `PROBLEM.md`, `TASKS.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `*_PLAN.md`, `*_ADR.md`, future docs.
- **Does NOT apply to public docs inside the filemark repo itself** — `filemark/README.md`, future `filemark/docs/**`, package READMEs, and any `*.md` checked into the public git history. Those are GitHub-rendered and must stay portable plain-markdown (no filemark-specific components).
- If `/filemark` skill not loaded in the session, load it first before drafting; do not freehand filemark components from memory.
